name: Channel3
description: Product search API and MCP over 150M+ products from 100,000+ brands, with live multi-retailer offers and commission-earning links for AI shopping agents. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Search Product Catalogs
skills.description: Finds products by natural-language query with filters for brand, price, retailer, color and attributes, with ranked offers.

skills.name: Search Products by Image
skills.description: Turns a photo or screenshot into matching product results across the Channel3 catalog.

skills.name: Look Up a Product URL
skills.description: Returns structured pricing, variants, images and merchant offers for any product URL in one response.

skills.name: Find Similar Products
skills.description: Returns products similar to a given item, for recommendations and alternatives in shopping apps.
